papers.title: Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates
papers.summary: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. papers.title: Multirobot Aerial Soft Manipulator for Floating Litter Collection
papers.summary: Removing floating litter from water bodies is crucial to preserving aquatic ecosystems and preventing pollution. In this work, we present a multirobot aerial manipulator for floating litter collection, leveraging the capabilities of aerial robots. The system is composed of two aerial robots connected by a rope, which supports a hook‐based tool for collecting floating litter. Compared to single‐aerial‐robot solutions, the use of two aerial robots increases payload capacity and flight endurance while reducing the downwash effect at the manipulation point, located at the midpoint of the rope. papers.title: DualSOM: Dual-mode software framework for clustering and classification using self-organising maps and sparse autoencoders
papers.summary: This work presents an open-source software framework for unsupervised clustering and supervised classification of high-dimensional data, demonstrated on human posture recognition from RGB-D skeletal inputs. The software combines sparse autoencoding for dimensionality reduction with a self-organising map trained using distance-based learning. A unified dual-mode pipeline supports both automatic clustering and label-based classification without changes to the model structure. papers.title: Centralized Reinforcement Learning for Shared-Target Tracking of Dual Soft Robotic Manipulators with B-Spline-Parameterized Distributed Actuation
papers.summary: Coordinated control of multiple soft robotic manipulators is challenging because continuous deformation, distributed actuation, and nonlinear dynamics increase both modeling and policy-learning complexity. papers.title: ActionABI: Evidence-first auditing of robot action-tensor contracts
papers.summary: A C++20/CUDA research tool for forensic recovery of undocumented robot action-tensor contracts. It scores a finite declared grammar on held-out trajectory episodes, retains calibrated equivalence sets instead of breaking ties, proposes bounded safe separating probes, and emits a converter only when every required field is supported by evidence. Its defining discipline is calibrated abstention, and its scoring core is exposed as a pybind11 fusion backend.
